audit.whatIsWrong: Three interaction errors. (a) Neither layer mentioned that Vision of Empire (W) reveals — it strips Going Rogue camouflage, which is the answer to his whole roam pattern. edits.before: With E online from Level 2 Akshan immediately learns to track it and swing away — his Heroic Swing has a shorter cooldown than your E, so you will miss roots if you fire into his swing path. Bait out Heroic Swing first by walking into range, then cast E the moment he commits to swinging back; if it lands, pull into Q burst for a real trade. At Level 6 his R becomes a point-and-click execute at range — never sit below 60% health without your own R toggled, because Demonic Ascension absorbs the damage and lets you drain back to safety. Force fights during Heroic Swing's cooldown window and refuse extended trades when it is available.
edits.after: With E online from Level 2 Akshan learns to track it and swing away — but Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1 against your 12s Nevermove, so the cooldown war is yours as long as you stop firing into his swing path. Remember the root is on the return pass: bait the grapple, then cast so the wave comes back through him, and pull into Q burst for a real trade. At Level 6 his R stores bullets and scales on your missing health — never sit low without your own R toggled, because Demonic Ascension drains you back out of that range. Force fights while Heroic Swing is down and refuse extended trades while it is up.

edits.before: Akshan's Heroic Swing comes online — he can dodge your E by swinging away mid-cast, so every root attempt must anticipate his grapple direction.
edits.after: Heroic Swing comes online at 18s — he swings clear of your E, but the root lands on the return pass, so cast past him and catch the grapple's landing.

edits.before: Track Akshan's Heroic Swing: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. When it is down — E-root + W pull drain.
edits.after: Track Heroic Swing (18s at rank 1). Your W reveals Going Rogue camouflage; his passive shields every third hit — bait it, then E-root.
